chapter: Las Vegas, Sinatra and later years
title: Playing in Sinatra's film 'Kings Go Forth'
summary: Sinatra called the trio for a cafe scene in the film, for which Norvo wrote a part for Pete Candoli.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Then came back and Sinatra called us to do a picture . Which we did. So after we finished --
Well don't -- well what was it like, what picture was it?
Well we just worked in a cafe scene, I had-- I had Richie Kamuca and it was Kings Go Forth, I think.

One that they made when it was an Army, with -- they made in Europe, and it was a cafe scene in Paris or something, so I wrote a thing for Pete Candoli, he asked me who should play the trumpet, because the other lead was going to play the trumpet .
